claims.claim: You can apply for Carer Support Payment online.
claims.quote: You can apply for Carer Support Payment and Carer Additional Person Payment: using the online form on the phone by post in person
claims.note: The application page explicitly lists the online form.

claims.claim: You can apply for Carer Support Payment by phone.
claims.quote: Call Social Security Scotland free on 0800 182 2222 to apply on the phone.
claims.note: The application page explicitly says to apply by phone.

claims.claim: Applicants provide details of the person cared for.
claims.quote: You also need details of the person, or people, you care for, including their: date of birth and address
claims.note: The page explicitly requests details of each person cared for.

claims.claim: Applicants must provide proof of care hours.
claims.quote: Carers will require to sign a declaration to confirm they are providing at least 35 hours of care per week for Carer Support Payment
claims.note: Applicants declare and sign for their care hours; the text does not require independent proof of those hours.
